title: 第239章 人道第一皇第238章 上岸第一剑废人教逐阐教
slug: 杨戬你爹从朝歌城考编回来了
content_zh:
这干完了人教干阐教，直接把轩辕黄帝的道心给干碎了。
就算是当年天皇伏羲也不敢发表如此逆天言论。
不过仔细想一想，如今连通天教主为了一正这乾坤都兵解了，这天道大势发生了如此倾斜，如今这人皇能有此举，也在常理之中。
黄帝挺直了自己的脊梁，站在泰山之下朝着人族九州看了过去。
熙熙攘攘的炊烟，百姓富足，军民一心，这便不是人族想要的盛世？
人族最终的愿景不过就是有安定的日子可以过，有充足的食物可以果腹，只此而已。
这封神量劫那么存在的意义又是什么？
非得要皇朝更迭，非要向天道俯首称臣，这才是真正的天理吗？
难道让人族过上好日子，这才是一个世界最根本的愿景吗？
“老夫已经老了，可人族的日子还需要继续，一代人有一代人的抗争方式，这便是我人族承载的神魂。”
“老夫只是祈愿，人定盛天，并非虚妄。”
“通天教主以兵解证遁去之一，我大商是人族最后之魂，若魂魄断绝，也绝不为天地奴役！！”
黄帝热泪盈眶的摇了摇头，正准备离去。
就在这个时候，只听杨易的声音传了过来，“今日轩辕黄帝大驾光临，便是为了见证玄皇归位，也是轩辕黄帝陛下亲自送来轩辕剑，助陛下镇压九州气运。”
也在杨易的声音传了出来之后没有多久，便见到泰山之上山呼海啸的声音传了出来。
“吾等拜见轩辕氏！！”
“拜见轩辕黄帝！！！”
“拜见人皇陛下！！！”
黄帝忍不住嘴角一抽，这是刚把自己架在了火上烤还不够，还要在伤口上撒上一把盐巴。
不过气氛已经烘托到了这个份上，黄帝也一步一步走向了祭坛。

杨易微微点头示意，帝辛则是双膝跪地，倒身下拜，“帝辛拜见人皇轩辕大帝。”
黄帝急忙上前将轩辕黄帝给扶了起来，然后拍了拍帝辛的肩膀，道：“好，很好，人道后继有人。”
黄帝走到了祭坛之上，看向了大商的文武百官，道：
“昔年，我轩辕氏逐鹿中原与蚩尤血战九隅，不是为了称霸天下，不是为了万世留名，只是为了让人族不再受战火侵扰，让百姓能在自家的田埂上安安稳稳地种下一粒种子，让母亲能在黄昏时分唤回玩耍的孩童，让每一个平凡的人族，都能有平凡地活着的权利。”
“后来我登临人皇之位，斩蚩尤、平四夷、定九州，以为这便是人族最盛之时，可当我退位归隐火云宫，封神量劫开启，我才明白，我当年打下的江山，不过是给人族挣了一口气，可这口气什么时候断，却从来不在人族的掌握之中。”
黄帝道音如同洪钟大吕震彻泰山之巅————
“天要我族俯首，圣人要我族称臣，连那一纸封神榜都标好了谁该生、谁该死、谁该上那榜上做那永世不灭的傀儡，可我人族，从来不是谁棋盘上的棋子！”
“遂祖钻木取火，是为了给自己取暖，有巢氏筑木为巢，是为了给自己一个遮风挡雨的地方，神农尝百草，是为了让子孙后代不再因一口毒草就丢了性命！”
“我人族每一步，都是靠自己一步一步走出来的！”
content_en:
After doing this, the Renjiao Ganchanjiao directly broke the Taoist heart of Emperor Xuanyuan Huang.
Even the Emperor Fuxi did not dare to make such outrageous remarks.
However, if you think about it carefully, now that the leader of Lian Tong Tian Cult has defeated all his troops in order to rectify the world, the general trend of heaven has tilted so much, and it is reasonable for the Human Emperor to do this now.
Huang Di straightened his spine, stood under Mount Tai and looked towards the human nine states.
Bustling with smoke, the people are prosperous, and the army and the people are united. Isn't this the prosperous age that the human race wants?
The ultimate vision of the human race is just to live a stable life and have enough food to satisfy their hunger, that's all.
What is the meaning of the existence of this god measuring tribulation?
We have to change dynasties and surrender to the law of heaven. Is this the true law of heaven?
Is letting human beings live a good life the most fundamental vision of a world?
"I am already old, but the life of the human race still needs to continue. Each generation has its own way of struggle. This is the soul that our race carries."
"I'm just praying that man will prosper and the sky will prosper. It's not an illusion."
"One of the leaders of Tongtian Cult escaped with the help of soldiers. I, Dashang, am the last soul of the human race. If my soul is cut off, I will never be enslaved by heaven and earth!!"
Huang Di shook his head with tears in his eyes and was about to leave.
At this time, Yang Yi's voice came over, "Today Emperor Xuanyuan Huang is here to witness the return of Emperor Xuan. It is also His Majesty Emperor Xuanyuan who personally sent the Xuanyuan Sword to help His Majesty suppress the luck of the Nine Provinces."
Not long after Yang Yi's voice came out, the sound of a tsunami coming from the mountains above Mount Tai was heard.
"Let's pay our respects to the Xuanyuan clan!!"
"Meet Emperor Xuanyuan!!!"
"Meet His Majesty the Emperor!!!"
Huang Di couldn't help but twitch the corner of his mouth. It was not enough to roast himself on the fire. He also had to sprinkle a handful of salt on the wound.
However, the atmosphere had already reached this point, and Huangdi also walked towards the altar step by step.
Yang Yi nodded slightly, while Di Xin knelt on his knees and bowed down, "Di Xin pays homage to the Emperor Xuanyuan."
Huang Di hurriedly stepped forward and helped Xuanyuan Huang Di up, then patted Di Xin on the shoulder and said: "Okay, very good, there is a successor to humanity."
Huang Di walked to the altar, looked at the civil and military officials of Dashang, and said:
"In the past, I, the Xuanyuan clan, competed in the Central Plains and fought bloody battles with Chi You, not to dominate the world, not to leave a name for eternity, but to prevent the human race from being disturbed by the flames of war, so that the people can safely plant a seed on the ridge of their own fields, so that mothers can call back their children playing at dusk, so that every ordinary human race can have the right to live an ordinary life."
"Later, when I ascended to the throne of the Human Emperor, killed Chi You, pacified the four barbarians, and conquered the Nine Provinces, I thought this was the time when the human race would be at its most prosperous. But when I abdicated the throne and retired to the Fire Cloud Palace, and the Conferred God Tribulation began, I realized that the empire I conquered back then was just a breath of relief for the human race. But when this breath will end, it is never within the control of the human race."
The Yellow Emperor's Taoist sound was like a bell that shook the top of Mount Tai————
"Heaven wants our clan to bow down, and the saint wants our clan to be its vassal. Even the list of gods has marked who should be born, who should die, and who should be on the list to be the eternal puppet. But my human race has never been a chess piece on anyone's chessboard!"
"Sui Zu drilled wood to make fire to keep himself warm. You Chao built a nest of wood to give himself a shelter from wind and rain. Shen Nong tasted hundreds of herbs so that future generations would no longer lose their lives due to a mouthful of poisonous weeds!"
"Every step I take as a human race is made step by step by myself!"
